title: Alice in Wonderland — Reading exercises
content: Read the book and complete the tasks.
1) What does Alice see before she follows the Rabbit?
a) A white Rabbit with a watch
2) Where does Alice go after following the Rabbit?
3) What does Alice find on the little table in the large room?
4) Why can't Alice enter the beautiful garden at first?
a) The door is too small.
b) The garden is too far away.
c) The door is locked forever.
___ The White Rabbit runs past Alice.
___ Alice finds a little gold key.
3. VOCABULARY — Match the words with their opposites.
4. GRAMMAR — Put the verbs in brackets into the Past Simple.
1) The Rabbit (take) a watch out of its pocket.
4) Alice (see) many shelves on the walls.
1) Why does Alice follow the Rabbit?
3) How does Alice feel when she cannot open the doors? Give one reason from the story.

5. Answers may vary. Suggested ideas: she is curious about the unusual Rabbit; Wonderland contains talking animals and strange events; Alice feels confused or frustrated because the doors are locked or too small.

questions.prompt: What does Alice see before she follows the Rabbit?
options: A white Rabbit with a watch
questions.explanation: The White Rabbit catches Alice's attention because he has a watch and seems unusual.

questions.prompt: Where does Alice go after following the Rabbit?
questions.explanation: Alice follows the Rabbit down the rabbit-hole.

questions.prompt: What does Alice find on the little table?
questions.explanation: She finds a little gold key on the table in the large room.

questions.prompt: Why can't Alice enter the beautiful garden at first?
options: The garden is too far away
questions.explanation: Alice cannot get through the little door because she is too big.

questions.prompt: Choose the Past Simple form: “The Rabbit ___ a watch out of its pocket.”
questions.explanation: The past form of the irregular verb take is took.

questions.prompt: Choose the Past Simple form: “Alice ___ after the Rabbit.”
questions.explanation: Start is a regular verb; its Past Simple form is started.

questions.prompt: Choose the Past Simple form: “She ___ down the hole.”
questions.explanation: The past form of the irregular verb fall is fell.

questions.prompt: Choose the Past Simple form: “Alice ___ many shelves on the walls.”
questions.explanation: The past form of see is saw.
